verified: Front: Siege (intrinsic); when it enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control, then that creature fights up to one target creature you don't control (the second target min 0). Back, Primordial Plasm: at the beginning of combat on your turn, another target creature gets +2/+2 and loses all abilities until end of turn (eff.edhv50.pump.loseall: a 7c +2/+2 and a layer-6 remove-all in one continuous effect with duration end of turn; 'another' is the other-than-the-source flag). Rulings read 2026-10-31: the creature that loses all abilities may later gain abilities (timestamp order); a creature whose P/T was defined by an ability gets base 0 plus +2/+2. CR 611.2a, 613.4c, 613.1f, 310 (Siege), 701.14a.

Enters with three ice counters (existing enters-with-counters, ice is a counter kind: CR 122.1b). As long as it has an ice counter, prevent all combat damage it would deal and it has defender (sta.edhv50.counter.preventDealt.defender: a static with the self-has-ice-counter condition, a prevention of combat damage whose source is itself, and a grant of defender; combat damage dealt TO it is not prevented). Whenever it blocks, remove an ice counter from it (existing trigger and removeCounters). Rulings read 2026-10-31: damage dealt to it is not prevented; the third block removes the last counter so that combat's damage is dealt. CR 615.1, 510.2, 611.3a, 702.3a.

As long as it is tapped, it is a Human Citizen with base power and toughness 1/1 and can't be blocked (sta.edhv50.aslong.self.is.subtype.basept.unblockable: a tapped condition on itself, creature types set to Citizen and Human in layer 4, base 1/1 in layer 7b, and a ban on being blocked); {2}{U}: untap it (existing). Rulings read 2026-10-31: the first ability's timestamp is when it entered, so later effects that set its power and toughness win; untapping an attacker does not remove it from combat. CR 205.1b, 613.4b, 509.1b, 611.3a.

For each artifact or creature card in target opponent's graveyard, add {C} and you gain 1 life (eff.edhv50.forEach.addC.gainLife): the target is a player (opponent), the one count is the artifact and creature cards (one filter, so an artifact creature counts once) in that player's graveyard, added as {C} for that many and as that much life. Ruling read 2026-10-31: an artifact creature card is not counted twice. CR 106.1, 119.1, 608.2c.

Any number of target creatures (min 0, max any) become the color of your choice until end of turn (eff.edhv50.group.becomesColorOfChoice: one choice of a color by you, then a layer-5 color set of every target to it), then draw a card. Ruling read 2026-10-31: you can choose zero targets and just draw. CR 105.3, 608.2d, 613.1e, 121.1.

Flash. When it enters, choose target player (eff.r3choose.choose.targetPlayer, promoted to stable by this round: the one target is any player); you create a tapped Powerstone token for each nonland card in that player's graveyard that was put there from the battlefield this turn (eff.edhv50.token.you.tapped.forEach: the count is the cards of that filter, putThereFrom battlefield and this turn, the tokens tapped and yours). Rulings read 2026-10-31: Powerstone is a predefined token; the tapped state is part of the instruction. CR 111.1, 110.5b, 700.4, 107.3.

+1: create a colorless artifact token named Etherium Cell with '{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color' (existing). -2: target creature gets +X/-X until end of turn, X the number of artifacts you control, counted as the ability resolves (existing). -7: you get an emblem with 'At the beginning of combat on your turn, target artifact you control becomes an artifact creature with base power and toughness 5/5' (eff.edhv50.becomes.artifactcreature.basept.permanent: layer 4 adds Artifact and Creature, layer 7b sets 5/5, duration permanent, which the ruling of 2017-02-09 says lasts indefinitely). CR 114.1, 611.2a, 613.4b, 205.1a, 606.

When it enters, search your library for any number of artifact and/or creature cards (min 0, max any), exile them (linked 'exiled', face up), then shuffle (existing). {4},{T}: choose a card at random that was exiled with it, put that card into its owner's hand (eff.edhv50.linked.chooseRandom: one random choice by no player among the linked cards, then the existing move to the hand). Rulings read 2026-10-31: you may find nothing; the cards are exiled face up; the card goes to its owner's hand. CR 607.2a, 608.2d, 701.19.
